contradiction_resolution: No claim-level contradiction: contradicts_claim_ids is empty and FND-0100 does not oppose CONJ-0001, THM-0001–THM-0007, OBS-0001, or RED-0001. Independent primary check: Stacks Project tag 056P defines a relative effective Cartier divisor as an effective Cartier divisor D with D→S flat; for a smooth proper relative curve of relative dimension 1, Stacks 0B9D/0B9C identify Hilb^d points with relative effective Cartiers that are finite locally free of degree d over the base (and 0B9E preserves finite local freeness under sum). Thus the universal degree-n divisor Gamma over Div^n_{C/S} is finite flat/locally free of degree n, not finite etale in general. Finite locally free of degree n is etale precisely where geometric fibres are etale of degree n (reduced support of n distinct separable points); that is exactly the reduced-support open already used by FND-0064 for the Conf_n→Div^n S_n-torsor. FND-0096 is adjudicated with the stronger hypothesis that Gamma is finite etale, so any use of as-stated FND-0096 over the whole of Div^6 is out of hypothesis precisely on non-reduced divisors—the locus where scheme-theoretic Fitting/determinantal structure exceeds the geometric-point content already flagged by FND-0046. The listed dimension counts (h^0=g+n-1, ker H^0(omega) of rank g, coker H^1(omega) of rank 1, perfect Serre pairing as intrinsic derivative) do not invoke etaleness of Gamma and are consistent with a finite-flat restatement, but that strengthening is not yet a discharged corpus theorem. Recommended action is therefore merge into FND-0096 as a scope/hypothesis repair: annotate safe domain as the reduced-support open, and only after re-proof replace ‘finite etale’ by ‘finite flat’ (or ‘finite locally free of degree n’). Not a free-standing geometric obstruction to Z, mono, or Tate type; not redundant with FND-0046/0064/0087/0098 (related neighbors, different claims); do not retire the content—fold it into FND-0096.
